paragraphs.text: TIMS DSH CUSTOMIZATIONS
# Tim's gadgets for DeepSeek Harness

The first and smallest gadget in this repository does exactly one thing: it **puts the
current time

next to the `dsh` logo** in the sidebar, coloured by the DeepSeek API price
tier that is running - *

*green** while **off-peak** hours are on, **red** during **peak**
hours. That is the whole feature;
everything below is how it works and how to install it.

Small, opinionated add-ons for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) -
every one of them a proper `dsh` plugin bu

ndle: install once, they survive restarts,
sessions and harness updates, and each can be switched of

f again from
**Settings > Plugins**.
Right now there is one gadget, and it is the one this repository was started for.
## Off-peak clock ⏱️ (DeepSeek API price tier, live in the sidebar)

A tiny clock next to the Harness logo, in the left sidebar, that tells you **which
DeepSeek API pric
e tier is running right now**:
| Colour | State | What it means |

| 🟢 green | **off-peak** | DeepSeek charges **half price** |
| 🔴 red | **peak** | full price - and t
he widget says `PEAK` next to the time |

Hover it and it tells you when the tier flips, in UTC - the time zone the pricing rules
are written

in. The screenshot at the top of this page is the real widget in its green
state at 06:33 UTC.
### Why the rules are not what you remember

DeepSeek has changed this schedule more than once, and the current policy (checked
2026-10-02 agains

t
Models & Pricing, footnote 2) is
inverted compared to the 2025-era one:

> Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. **Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and
> 06:00 - 10:00 UTC,

Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays.** All
> other hours are off-peak, includi
ng weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.

So off-peak is the *default* and green is the normal state; red marks the two weekday
windows. The c

lock knows the Chinese statutory holidays, which matters more than it
sounds: a holiday week is off-

peak all day, and a naive weekday check would show red
during exactly the busiest weeks of the year.

To move to the next year, add the new holidays to `packages/suite/src/features/offpeak.ts`
*and* `pa

ckages/suite/client/offpeak.client.js` (two copies - see
packages/suite/README.md for why), then reb

s/suite/client/offpeak.client.js` (two copies - see
packages/suite/README.md for why), then rebuild.
### Install it

You need DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` (the pinned runtime), Node.js >= 20.10 and
pnpm 9+:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or without the CLI: in the app, **Settings > Plugins > Add plugin**, and paste the
absolute path of

the `packages/suite` directory. Then **restart the app** - a bundle is
loaded at startup - and the c
lock appears next to the logo while the sidebar is expanded.

Switching the `dsh-offpeak` row off in Settings > Plugins only stops the Host-side
configuration; th

e widget itself is served by the bundle's Client anchor row, so disable
that row (or remove the bund

le) to take the clock away. Removing the bundle restores the
default `DeepSeek Harness` wordmark:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

One honest trade-off, by design: the widget takes the seat beside the logo, so while it is
active it

**replaces the wordmark**, and clicking that row still starts a new session
(it is the shell's New-
session button). It also only exists while the sidebar is expanded.
## What else is in the box

The bundle also carries a `hello` row - a one-line tool, kept as a smoke test that a row
is active a

nd its tool is callable. It is harmless, and a good reference for writing your
own first gadget.
## Writing your own gadget

Everything in this repository is one bundle (`packages/suite`) with one row per feature,
plus the sc
affolding to add more:
| Task | Command |

| add a feature (row + module) | `pnpm new-feature suite weather` |
| add a bundle | `pnpm new-bundl

e tools` |
| build / typecheck all bundles | `pnpm build` / `pnpm typecheck` |
| check runtime pins

against the installed dsh | `pnpm check` |
| any launcher command | `node scripts/dsh.mjs <args>` |
| Document | Content |

| docs/architecture.md | rows, bundles, layer order, module resolution, when to split |
| docs/plugi

n-development.md | writing a feature: tools, schemas, Config, client UI, pitfalls |
| docs/install-a
nd-reload.md | install into a profile, reload semantics, verification, troubleshooting |

A UI gadget is a *client half*: hand-written plain JavaScript in `client/`, served through
a `./clie

nt` export. It is the part with sharp edges - a bundle that ships one needs
exactly one row named af

ter the package, and that row's module must export `apply`, or the
browser half is dropped from the

page with no error anywhere. Both failure modes are
written down, with the diagnostic that tells the

m apart, in
docs/plugin-development.md section 7. Templates to start
from: `templates/bundle/` and `
templates/client/decoration.client.js`.

Pinned runtime: `dsh 0.2.0-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.4`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2`.

After a harness update run `pnpm check`: it compares
every bundle manifest with the installed runtim
e and prints the exact edits needed.
## Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Generated `lib/` directories are build output and are git-ignored - never edit them.
## The model in one screen
| Layer | What it is | Unit of |
| **Row** | one entry in the Cordis tree: `id`, `name`, `config` | activation: switch it on/off and

configure it in Settings > Plugins |
| **Bundle** | a package whose `package.json` declares `dsh.bun

dle.patch` | installation, versioning, publishing |
| **Feature** | one row inside this repo, implem
ented by one module under `src/features/` | so one capability changes without touching the others |

One bundle carries many feature rows. Add a second bundle only when a feature needs its own
dependen

cies, its own release cadence, or has to be shared with someone else. Details:
docs/architecture.md.
## Requirements
| Tool | Version | Note |

| Node.js | >= 20.10 | the tooling in this repository |
| pnpm | 9 or newer | workspace install and

build |
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2 | the Desktop app; the bundle pins must match it |
